analysis.reasonEn: RSI moved from 38.8 to 39.7, exiting oversold but remaining in neutral territory. MACD histogram slightly worsened from -2.3783 to -2.4787, showing no trend reversal signal. ADX at 26.5 indicates a clear trend, but the price increase from the 5-day low ($320.23) to the current price ($329.17) is limited, and the 5-day high ($341.10) was not breached. The price is consolidating near the 20-day Bollinger Band middle line ($347.69), showing a lack of direction. Trading volume is at 0.89 of the 5-day average, indicating normal activity. As a 15-year swing trader, the current indicators do not provide a clear buy or sell signal, making a wait-and-see approach optimal.
